proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ P hP
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have hp : IsStarProjection P := ⟨hP, hs⟩
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hp
    rw [h4]
    exact Submodule.starProjection_norm_le _
  · intro hn
    have hsym : (P : H →ₗ[𝕜] H).IsSymmetric := by
      have hid : IsIdempotentElem (P : H →ₗ[𝕜] H) := by
        ext x
        exact congrArg (fun F => F x) hP
      rw [LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isSymmetric_iff_isOrtho_range_ker hid, Submodule.isOrtho_iff_inner_eq]
      rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩ z hz
      have hz' : P z = 0 := hz
      set y := P u with hy
      have hPy : P y = y := congrArg (fun F => F u) hP
      by_cases hz0 : z = 0
      · simp [hz0]
      have hzz : (inner 𝕜 z z : 𝕜) ≠ 0 := inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hz0
      set c : 𝕜 := inner 𝕜 z y / inner 𝕜 z z with hc
      have h0 : inner 𝕜 z (y - c • z) = 0 := by
        rw [inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, hc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hzz, sub_self]
      have h1 : inner 𝕜 (y - c • z) (c • z) = 0 := by
        rw [inner_smul_right, ← inner_conj_symm, h0]; simp
      have h2 := norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero (𝕜 := 𝕜) (y - c • z) (c • z) h1
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h2
      have h3 : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y - c • z‖ := by
        have e : P (y - c • z) = y := by rw [map_sub, map_smul, hz', smul_zero, sub_zero, hPy]
        calc ‖y‖ = ‖P (y - c • z)‖ := by rw [e]
          _ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖y - c • z‖ := P.le_opNorm _
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖y - c • z‖ := by gcongr
          _ = ‖y - c • z‖ := one_mul _
      have h5 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖y - c • z‖ ^ 2 := (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).mpr h3
      have h6 : ‖c • z‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have h7 : ‖c • z‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (c • z)]
      have h8 : c = 0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h7)).resolve_right hz0
      have h9 : inner 𝕜 z y = 0 := by
        rw [hc, div_eq_zero_iff] at h8
        exact h8.resolve_right hzz
      change inner 𝕜 y z = 0
      rw [← inner_conj_symm, h9]; simp
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr hsym
